# Bhumika Choudhary (Sara)

> Seattle based operations and supply chain candidate. 4 years in risk, compliance and fraud operations at Uber (Aug 2022 to May 2026). Master of Supply Chain Management student at the UW Foster School of Business, graduating June 2027. Targeting management roles in operations, supply chain, risk and programs.

## Experience at Uber
- SQRC Specialist I, Aug 2022 to Aug 2023: investigated 2,000+ fraud cases across the US and Canada.
- Risk and Compliance Specialist II, Aug 2023 to May 2025: managed a global appeals queue of 5,000+ cases.
- Risk and Compliance Specialist III, May 2025 to May 2026: global subject matter expert guiding 90+ team members worldwide on policy and quality; quality frameworks that cut process errors by about 40%.

## Projects
- TrustBridge: a framework that decides escalation and empathy in AI customer support as explicit, testable judgment, modeled on 82,779 real tickets.
- Uber Eats India: a market reentry plan after a $244M loss, team project at Foster.
- Nordstrom Canada: a relaunch strategy after a $775M closure, team project at Foster.
- HuskyPerks: a mobile web app of 244 student perks for UW, built solo.

## Articles
- [Why AI Customer Service Fails at the Handoff: One Missing Check](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/why-ai-customer-service-fails-handoff-one-missing-check-choudhary-i63bc/): published Sep 29, 2026. Argues that support bots should check, before replying, whether they can actually complete the request, so they hand off on the first request instead of after 10+.
